messages.subject: [RESULT][VOTE] Airflow Providers - release preparation date 2026-10-17
messages.body:
Hello,

Apache Airflow Providers prepared on 2026-10-17 have been accepted.

3 "+1" binding votes received:
- Jarek Potiuk
- Shahar Epstein
- Kaxil Naik

The released provider is common.ai 1.0.0 (voted as 1.0.0rc3), the first
stable release of the provider.

Vote thread: https://lists.apache.org/thread/zmqm5tpcv6c0vz34n2l5kqktfolnn40f

I'll continue with the release process, and the release announcement
will follow shortly.

Cheers,
Jarek Potiuk
